meta.semantics: caller-side EAX pointer/array consumption (RETX window). window: forward from insn after call X until all tracked regs overwritten; mov r2,<tracked> copy extension (<=2 tracked regs); <=12 real instructions; crosses labels and conditional jumps; ends at retn/uncond jmp/function end; call kills eax/ecx/edx but tracked copies in ebx/esi/edi survive.

rules.ptrstep: tracked r; add r,N (N>=2) or lea r2,[r+N], then mov/movsx/movzx r3,[r(+K)] read => return is T* with width(T)==N; candidates = universe pointer spellings with element width N U {C*: class_layouts size(C)==N}
rules.idxscale: memory access [tracked + idx*N] (load or store), N in {2,4,8} => return is array base of N-byte elements; same width candidate map as ptrstep
rules.derefstore: mov [tracked+O], val, O>=0x40 => C18 member-store; candidates = classes with member at O (anchors/member_types.json)
rules.derefstore-vt: value is offset <vtable> (??_7 mangled via vtable_slot_authority, or off_/dword_ VA via rtti_vtable_class.json) => return IN {class} U rtti-descendants (strong; any O incl. 0)
rules.excluded: cmp/test-null-only windows (weak, MUST-NOT); stride<2 (width-1 stepping not collected); second add on a stepped reg (ambiguous); base+index without explicit scale; tracked reg as index (not base)
